message: The other day, my son asked why we always have our go-bags ready by the door. I smiled and shared a funny story from when I was his age—my family had to scramble during a storm without any prep. Fast forward to now, and it feels pretty smug to say, "I told you so!" But really, it’s just about being ready for whatever life throws our way. I’d love to hear your tips on keeping your family prepared! 😊
